patronOf.en-US: Friends of the Lord at Bethany

prayerExcerpt.en-US: You are the Christ, the Son of God, who is coming into this world.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Tu és o Cristo, Filho do Deus vivo, que vieste a este mundo.

meta.face: Martha: a woman of about thirty-five, strong and wholesome, with a round face, rosy cheeks, chestnut hair tucked under the head-cloth, steady brown eyes and a frank, kindly look toward the viewer. Mary: a younger woman of about twenty-five, with a delicate oval face, long dark wavy hair loose over her shoulders, large dark eyes lowered to the alabaster jar and a still, listening expression. Lazarus: a lean man of about fifty with a pale, gaunt, gentle face, receding short grey-streaked black hair, clean-shaven and dark eyes raised in quiet gratitude; not curly-haired, not long-haired.
meta.basis: No tradition fixes their faces, so the three are set apart by age, colouring and attribute, following the Gospel roles the 2021 decree names: Martha serving, Mary listening, Lazarus raised. Mary is kept veiled and dark-haired so she does not repeat the Magdalene card.
